content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A corrected resubmission or records-only resubmission would not cure the authorization defect and risks an avoidable denial. Because a denial is on file and the payer path is not exhausted, the proper next step is a formal appeal supported by medical necessity.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
